statement: ∀ (f : Module.End ℂ V) (L : LR.Lift M f), ∃ aR : Module.End (LR.R p) (LR.MR p M), (∀ w, (aR w : V) = f w) ∧ (∀ m, aR (LR.embed p M m) = LR.embed p M (L.map m))
proof:
intro f L
have hs : LR.MR p M ≤ (LR.MR p M).comap (f.restrictScalars (LR.R p)) := by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  intro m hm
  change f m ∈ LR.MR p M
  rw [← L.agrees ⟨m, hm⟩]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (L.map ⟨m, hm⟩).property
let aR : Module.End (LR.R p) (LR.MR p M) := (f.restrictScalars (LR.R p)).restrict (fun w hw => hs hw)
refine ⟨aR, fun w => rfl, ?_⟩
intro m
apply Subtype.ext
exact (L.agrees m).symm

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type) [fieldK : Field K] (l : ℕ) (V : Type) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V]
  (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ l < p →
    LR.N1 l x y h v →
      (LR.N2 p l M x y v ∧ ∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ LR.localRing p ↔ ∃ a d, ¬↑p ∣ d ∧ q = ↑a / ↑d) →
        LR.N3 p l M y v →
          (∀ (c : CharP K p) (rho : LR.R p →+* K) (sigma : LR.R p →+* ZMod p),
              LR.ResidueMaps K p c rho sigma → LR.Transport K p M c rho sigma) →
            ∀ (f : Module.End ℂ V) (L : LR.Lift M f),
              ∃ aR, (∀ (w : ↥(LR.MR p M)), ↑(aR w) = f ↑w) ∧ ∀ (m : ↥M), aR (LR.embed p M m) = LR.embed p M (L.map m)
